arguments.summary: A critical lateral movement incident was detected from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14) to the domain controller (10.0.8.200). The initial compromise occurred via a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell command from Outlook, leading to the execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon. The attacker performed credential dumping and used pass-the-hash techniques to move laterally. Despite detection, administrative actions to disable logging and open forensic ports were denied, delaying response. No containment or eradication actions were executed during this phase.
